title: Rooftop Rodeo • Hot Tub, FirePit • 3mi to Broadway
description:
Stay just 2 miles from Downtown Nashville & Broadway in this luxury 4BR/4.5BA retreat! Sleeps 12 with 2 king suites, 2 queen beds & a fun bunk room. Perfect for families, groups & bachelor/bachelorette trips. Your private rooftop oasis features a hot tub, fire pit, BBQ, outdoor dining, life-size games & skyline views. Enjoy FREE parking, Smart TVs, fast Wi-Fi & a full kitchen—all near Broadway, Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena & Music Row! 🎸♨️

The space
Welcome to Your Nashville Rooftop Retreat
